title: An inner variable hides an outer variable of the same name inside its block only
query: EVALUATE ROW ( "r", VAR x = 1 RETURN x + SUMX ( T, VAR x = T[n] * 10 RETURN x ) )

source.quote: the outer Result is not visible in the inner block because it is being hidden by a closer variable with the same name
source.supports: a closer variable hides an outer variable with the same name

derivation: Inside SUMX the inner x (10, 20, 30) hides the outer x: the sum is 60. Outside the inner block x is still 1: 1 + 60 = 61.
alternative: The article reuses a name in a nested block, but there the outer variable is still being defined; no source shows redefining a variable that is already in scope. If the engine rejects that, the query fails with an error instead of returning 61.
